summary: A trial of automated AI code review using Claude was launched for new Apache Spark pull requests, posting only advisory comments without approvals. The bot triggers on new or updated PRs, respects open review comments, and can be disabled per PR via a GitHub label, with safeguards to limit Jira API usage. The proposal introduces SPIP, a unified API and execution protocol that enables user-defined functions to run across multiple programming languages via inter-process communication. Vote in progress: 0 binding +1 Uroš Bojanić proposes cutting a 4.0.5 release candidate after the 4.1.4 RC2, noting that the 4.0 branch has accumulated many fixes and will soon reach its 18‑month support window.
